toxicity.Notes: Acute toxicity of zinc N-(2-hydroxyacetophenone)glycinate: a single intraperitoneal injection of different concentrations of ZnNG, vehicle or nothing, six mice per group, clinical appearance evaluated daily. The authors state that 100 mg/kg body weight is the LD50 but do not list the doses tested, the mortality at each dose, the calculation method or the observation period, so those fields stay empty. The sub-lethal doses used afterwards, 1/7 and 1/5 of the LD50, that is 15 and 20 mg/kg, produced no toxic symptoms or pathological change after 72 h; they belong to the organ toxicity pass, not here. The antitumour work in the same paper is an Ehrlich ascites carcinoma model scored by increase in life span, which has no tumour growth inhibition and is left for the Survival pass.
